title: Concept: Access token issued with a very long lifetime
description: A token expiry measured in weeks beside the token field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A long-lived token cannot be revoked before it expires without extra state, so a single leak stays usable for the whole window.
applicability: Deployments that render a token expiry measured in weeks beside the token field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A long-lived token cannot be revoked before it expires without extra state, so a single leak stays usable for the whole window.
